title: Potential of a mammalian and avian environmental DNA metabarcoding assay as a tool for fecal pollution source tracking in river waters
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, 11,365-376
DOI: 10.1039/D4EW00535J, Paper
Akihiko Hata, Yuno Meuchi, Keisuke Kuroda, Kenshi Sankoda, Seiya Hanamoto
A variety of animal DNA in surface water was identified by a metabarcoding approach. They corresponded to host-specific Bacteroidales markers, highlighting the potential of this approach for comprehensively identifying pollution sources.
